headline: King Mohammed VI Names Morocco's First Woman Prime Minister
deck: The royal palace said Fatima Ezzahra El Mansouri was appointed on Tuesday after her liberal-centrist party finished first in the 23 September election.
body: King Mohammed VI on Tuesday appointed Fatima Ezzahra El Mansouri as Morocco's first woman prime minister, the royal palace said. [E2][E1]
The appointment followed her liberal-centrist party's first-place finish in the 23 September parliamentary election. [E2]
Al Jazeera describes El Mansouri as the second woman in the Arab world to serve in the post. [E1]
